news.title: 人工智能在尽职调查中的应用研究
news.snippet: 发表于《World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews》2025年第27卷第2期，探讨AI在尽职调查中的创新应用与风险评估。
news.raw_snippet: World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews, 2025, 27(02), 2035-2076 Publication history: Received on 18 July 2025; revised on 24 August 2025; accepted on 26 August 2025 Article DOI: https://doi.org/10.30574/wjarr.2025.27.2.3057 Abstract Background: Artificial intelligence integration in due diligence procedures of mega-large merger acquisition dealings has been brought out as a powerful method in the American business world. Advanced analytics and machine learning algorithms have proven to hold a lot of promise in terms of improving the accuracy of the evaluation of transactions, and also in terms of mitigating time pressures that are normally promulgated in view of intricate MandA assessments. We have applied the machine learning algorithms based on AdaBoost and support vector machine models as a predictive analysis. Results: Analysis indicated that AI-based due diligence platforms have a prediction accuracy of 80.1% in the determination of merger success when compared to traditional approaches, which had 62.7% accuracy.

news.title: AI产品与服务发布动态 - 2026年7月13日
news.snippet: Voya Partners扩展SinglepointAI合作；Amplify发布新品。汇总最新AI商业合作与产品发布资讯。
news.raw_snippet: Voya Partners expands SinglepointAI partnership; Amplify launches custody solutions for RIAs; First Recon AI rolls out security platform; and more. Voya Financial Inc. announced a new application programming interface integration with SinglepointAI Inc. that will add artificial-intelligence-enabled technology and data connectivity to the retirement plan onboarding process for third-party administrators. The integration will connect SinglepointAI and Voya’s digital onboarding platform to reduce manual processes, improve data accuracy and deliver a more streamlined onboarding. The integrated platform delivers the custody account opening operations and capabilities of GSCS, with client data flowing directly into Amplify’s artificial-intelligence-powered data. The platform is expected to eliminate data fragmentation and to combine custody, trading, investment management, service and billing data into a single environment built for independent advisers. First Recon AI publicly launched AI Security Runtime, a platform expected to govern and secure how enterprises use artificial intelligence across an organization.
